knowledge:
- key_parameters: <userSets=A GRanges or GRangesList object containing the genomic regions of interest ;; userUniverse=A GRanges object representing the background universe of all tested regions ;; regionDB=A loaded region database list object returned by loadRegionDB() ;; cores=Number of CPU cores to use for parallel processing in runLOLA() ;; includeSplits=A logical parameter in writeCombinedEnrichment() that, when TRUE, writes separate result tables for each userSet ;; collections=A character vector specifying database collections to extract in getRegionSet() ;; filenames=A character vector specifying database filenames to extract in getRegionSet()>
- alternatives: <Gene set analysis is mentioned as a traditional alternative, but it is limited because it requires gene-centric data and cannot easily handle non-coding regulatory elements like enhancers.>
- when_to_use: <Use this package when you have genomic region sets (e.g., ChIP-seq peaks, differential methylation regions, ATAC-seq peaks) and want to identify which public regulatory elements, transcription factor binding sites, or chromatin states they significantly overlap with relative to a specific background universe.>
- pitfalls: <Choosing an inappropriate background universe (the universe must represent the complete set of regions that had a chance of being selected, otherwise the Fisher's exact test significance values will be biased or incorrect) ;; Running runLOLA on individual region sets separately instead of combining them into a single GRangesList (combining them is much faster and more efficient).>

workflows.name: genomic_region_enrichment_analysis
workflows.intent: Run enrichment analysis on user-provided genomic region sets against a reference database using a custom background universe, and extract/save the results.
input: setA_100.bed (BED file of genomic regions of interest)
setB_100.bed (BED file of genomic regions of interest)
setC_100.bed (BED file of genomic regions of interest)
activeDHS_universe.bed (BED file of the background universe of tested regions)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the reference database using loadRegionDB ;; 2. Read user region sets and the background universe using readBed ;; 3. Combine user region sets into a GRangesList ;; 4. Run the enrichment analysis using runLOLA ;; 5. Order and explore results ;; 6. Write results to files using writeCombinedEnrichment ;; 7. Extract specific overlapping regions for a given result using extractEnrichmentOverlaps
workflows.code:
library("LOLA")
regionDB = loadRegionDB("LOLACore/hg19")
regionSetA = readBed("lola_vignette_data/setA_100.bed")
regionSetB = readBed("lola_vignette_data/setB_100.bed")
regionSetC = readBed("lola_vignette_data/setC_100.bed")
activeDHS = readBed("lola_vignette_data/activeDHS_universe.bed")
userSets = GRangesList(regionSetA, regionSetB, regionSetC)
locResults = runLOLA(userSets, activeDHS, regionDB, cores=1)
locResults[order(meanRnk, decreasing=FALSE),][1:20,]
writeCombinedEnrichment(locResults, outFolder= "lolaResults", includeSplits=TRUE)
oneResult = locResults[2,]
extractEnrichmentOverlaps(oneResult, userSets, regionDB)
